rawContent: #BLM doesn't mean unless you've been arrested, skipped school, done drugs, had a fight, carried a weapon, braided your hair, had too much to drink, gotten tattoos, cursed, bought skittles, jogged, gotten a ticket, passed out in the drive-thru, sold loosies. It means #BLM #period!

Our people don’t have the luxury of thinking #BLM is a fad we can float in and out of when we get scared and white nationalists embed in and wreak havoc on. Tomorrow we’re still gonna be Black dealing w/pandemics, job loss, homelessness, hurricanes, death and y’all’s indifference
